name: Mek Fastdakka

bonuses.name: Champion
bonuses.text: Mek Fastdakka may use Ruin Actions, and has 2 personal Ruin.

abilities.name: Mekaniak
abilities.text: Mek Fastdakka can repair any damaged piece of equipment or weapon within 1 metre. He can also reload a weapon that runs out of ammo without spending an action.

abilities.name: Orky Upgradez
abilities.text: As a Free Action, Mek Fastdakka may spend 1 Ruin to tinker with a ranged weapon within 1 metre. The weapon gains +1d3 ED and +1d3 AP for its next attack. The next time the weapon is fired, a Complication triggers if the Wrath Die lands on a 1, 2 or 3.

note: No Tier row printed; class proposed (Champion with 2 personal Ruin; a Champion under 7 Wounds is E, as Bloody Gates' Cravax). No salvo printed on the Shoota or Big Shoota (field omitted).
